expectation: Membrane ring on cytotoxic T cells, a subset of CD3+ cells. Moderately common: scattered single cells in tumour and stroma, denser in lymphoid aggregates or infiltrates. Expect discrete ringed cells against dark tissue, not haze.
observed: A: discrete yellow dots in every image, dense in infiltrated regions and sparse elsewhere. B/C: a few sharp ringed cells on dark background. D: membrane rings. E: crisp CD8a rings within a subset of the CD3 field, with white overlap and some green.
why: Discrete membrane-ringed cells, varying in density between regions and sitting on a subset of CD3+ cells, form a clear specific population.
notes: CD8a lights sharp membrane rings on scattered cells that cluster in infiltrated regions. In the CD3-dense field, most CD8a cells overlap CD3 (white) and background is clean. This is a real stain.
